Context: 20. Commercial Employment after Retirement

Retired Group 'B' Officers need not get prior sanction of the Government. They should intimate the office they served last before retirement if they take up any commercial employment within one year of their retirement. The intimation should contain information as to whether or not they have had any official dealing while in Government service, with the private employer, with whom they are taking up the employment.GID (5), Rule 9.
